title: Working as an electrician and hearing the colored bands at the De Soto Hotel
summary: Asked about raids, La Rocca says he was not allowed in the place but worked as an electrician for a construction company and heard the colored bands play at the De Soto Hotel.

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers
story.community_name: Where I came from: parents, siblings and birth

blocks.x: Raiding, there were no raiding. Absolutely no greeners. Were they fake at all? I don't know. I wasn't allowed in the place. Oh, I see. The how come, I used to be an electrician in my early days. And many times I was sent to DeSoto Hotel to do work over underneath there. You know, they were on electrical equipment. Or some line would go out and I'd have to pull new wires through it. I worked for Mark's construction company at that time. That was down in 531 Island Institute. That was the biggest, largest electrical construction in the South. These people wired at places like Monroe, electrical power places. all through the Louisiana. Zimmerman Lumber Company run an auxiliary line from Zimmerman, Louisiana into Monroe, which is about 10, 15 miles. I climbed every pole in there, put every high power line that was ever put in Monroe in the beginning. I worked on all that. and that's how I used to hear the colored band because whenever I went down there and they had some functioning in the De Soto Hotelers, most of all they used to give them, I could hear them playing.
